feeds.title: Babcock Ranch Blog
feeds.description: Explore our blog section for the latest news and tips from Babcock Ranch, a sustainable city in South Florida. Babcock Ranch has been thoughtfully designed to help residents live their happiest, healthiest life. Situated on 18,000 acres, adjacent to an extensive wilderness preserve, Babcock Ranch features hiking and biking paths, greenways, and lakes perfect for outdoor adventures.

feeds.title: Vista Verde Ranch Blog
feeds.description: There is so much for us to tell you about Vista Verde to help you! We are a passionate group of people who call this ranch our home, and we want to welcome in guests who will feel the same about the ranch. We are strongly committed to providing the many benefits to our guests that come with our all-inclusive vacation ranch packages. Put your wallet away and just choose what you want to do each day based on how you're feeling and what sounds interesting, rather than worrying about the cost.

feeds.title: Sterling Ranch Colorado Blog
feeds.description: Catch up on all of the recent news from Sterling Ranch and find information about events taking place and more about living in the community. With its rolling terrain and spectacular views of majestic mountains and sweeping foothills, Sterling Ranch is the home you've been seeking for the next chapter of your life. Vitalized by state-of-the-art technologies and a mindful approach to sustainable resources, this mixed-use, master-planned community is unlike any other.

feeds.title: Ranching Heritage Association Blog
feeds.description: Although the museum and historical park at Texas Tech University were not formally dedicated until 1976, the concept of a center to preserve the history of ranching began in 1966 with a unique partnership between Texas Tech and the Ranching Heritage Association, a non-profit member organization that supports the efforts of the center. With all but five of its 55 historic structures between 100 and 200 years old, the historical park speaks volumes about the frontier settlers who lived in those structures and created legends and history in the process.

feeds.title: Tom Hutton M.D. Blog
feeds.description: I am a man, a husband, a father, and a grandfather. I am a retired neurologist with an interest in behavior, a relatively new rancher, and a humanist. Much of my earlier works were scientific, medical, and advice for persons suffering from or caring for those with neurological disorders. Now I aspire to write for popular audiences, especially describing the wisdom expressed in patient stories, the wonder of Border collies, and the enjoyment of retired life in the Texas Hill Country.

feeds.title: The Hermits' Rest » Ranch Life
feeds.description: Read articles on Ranch Life by The Hermits' Rest. Please join us as we make notes about our little part of the world. See what's happening at the ranch, and learn what's boiling up from my subconscious. There's always something going on!

feeds.title: Ogilvie Stock Ranch Blog
feeds.description: We are located south of Kamloops, British Columbia, and have been raising Registered Horned Hereford cattle since 1974. We strive to provide buyers with consistent and high-performing cattle that can handle traveling the range and pastures of British Columbia. We have a registered Horned Hereford herd and a commercial herd of Hereford influence cattle. We also sell pasture-raised grass-fed beef, grain-fed beef, and grass-fed lamb locally.

feeds.title: Buzzard's Beat
feeds.description: A blog about life on a Kansas ranch, the life of a cowgirl, Cooking, moving cattle, and going down the rodeo trail or running by Buzzard. The husband and wife operate a small ranch in southeast Kansas where they spend a large chunk of time rodeoing, running, and engaging in a rural community.

feeds.title: Day in the Life at Longview Ranch Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about Longview Ranch in Oregon through the blog. Located along Central Oregon's historic Route 19 in Kimberly, Longview Ranch maintains 30,000 stunning acres of diverse landscape.

feeds.title: A Land of Grass Ranch Blog
feeds.description: At A Land of Grass Ranch, our mission is to raise livestock in an environmentally and economically sustainable manner and to teach others about how and why we do it this way.

feeds.title: Down Home Ranch
feeds.description: Our blog posts provide an insider's look into the happenings of Down Home Ranch. Read on to learn more about the current atmosphere of the Ranch and what's being done to empower lives. Down Home Ranch is a nonprofit near Austin that empowers the lives of people with intellectual and developmental disabilities through various opportunities.

feeds.title: V6 Ranch Blog
feeds.description: Read about everyday ranch life and the ramblings and ponderings of an 80-something-year-old rancher, Jack Varian. Jack is the owner and manager of the V6 Ranch, a working cattle ranch enveloping 20,000 acres of the most diverse and alluring country in the heart of Central California.

feeds.title: Wildwood Hills Ranch Blog
feeds.description: Read about what is happening at Wildwood Hills Ranch, weekly newsletters, parent information, mission teams, leadership, and more! Wildwood Hills Ranch of Iowa exists to transform lives and strengthen communities by providing healing, hope, and God's unconditional love to children and youth at risk.

feeds.title: Western Horseman » Ranching
feeds.description: Read about the ranch lifestyle and more in this Ranching segment of Western Horseman. For more than 85 years, Western Horseman has shared the wisdom of the world's finest horseman and horsewoman, taken readers to the West's greatest ranches, and offered unique, behind-the-scenes coverage of rodeos, cowboy gatherings, and competitive events, stories not found in any other magazine.

feeds.title: Rocking Bar H
feeds.description: We are the Hickle family - first-generation producers of Red Angus genetics for purebred operations and commercial cattlemen alike. We also custom farm, produce & offer a variety of retail hay, & bring a bit of ranch life to you through our online Ranch Goods store.

feeds.title: Windy N Ranch Blog
feeds.description: A family-owned diversified meat ranch in the heart of Washington State. We are a family-owned, diversified meat ranch in Ellensburg, Washington run by two generations of ranchers. Each of us is passionate about and committed to producing clean, nutritious, and flavorful meats and eggs while upholding the highest standards in animal husbandry, holistic ranching, and the humane treatment of animals.

feeds.title: Rockside Ranch Blog
feeds.description: Rockside Ranch has always been about two things: raising good food and living better stories. From graduate testimonies to how we got started, to our recipes and traditions, we're sharing it all right here. Too many young men are living in crisis - and it is destroying their lives. Rockside helps young men overcome crises and live the life they were created to live. A crisis can be the middle of the story, it doesn't have to be the end.

feeds.title: Lonesome Dove Ranch
feeds.description: Ross and Tara, along with their children, own and operate Lonesome Dove Ranch, located in southwest Saskatchewan near Ponteix. We have been raising and breeding beef cattle for most of our lives. Our ranching operation consists of purebred red and black Gelbvieh cattle, commercial Gelbvieh cattle, working ranch horses, and registered Border Collie dogs.

feeds.title: Cattleist Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Gabriella. I am a momma to two, a wifey, and my other favorite title, a rancHer. I am a complete homebody, and I want to bring my love for ranching and passion for the rural living right to you. Perhaps you have questions about beef, how it is raised, or how to cook it. If it has to do with cattle, I am your girl!

feeds.title: Jorasz Family Ranch Blog
feeds.description: A place where Teri shares fun and sometimes emotional stories about life on our ranch. Welcome to JFR's Sovereign Acres- Jorasz Family Ranch, where all our critters are family-raised, right from the start!All of our animals are raised on pasture, out in the warm sunshine, eating a diet as close to what nature intended as our climate will allow. We pasture raise red Angus beef, heritage Hereford and Duroc pork, Brown Swiss Cows, and now, American Bison!

feeds.title: Ranch Sellers Blog
feeds.description: As ranch owners, we know the intricacies that come with buying or selling a legacy ranch. We put a combined 40 years of true-life ranch experience to work for you when you buy or sell your ranch. From maintaining strict privacy and confidentiality to truly understanding your goals and objectives, we are committed to your complete satisfaction. Whether buying a legacy ranch or finding the perfect buyer for your ranch, we have the knowledge and patience to navigate the process.

feeds.title: Strickland Ranch
feeds.description: Jim has six decades of ranching experience and comes from a family that has been ranching in Florida since the Civil War. Jim grew up ranching with his father along the west coast of Florida. Jim is the owner of Strickland Ranch. Jim is a passionate advocate for Florida agriculture and conservation.

feeds.title: Five Mary's Farm Blog
feeds.description: Sharing our ranch life, recipes, and more Five Marys with you. Mary and Brian started their family in Menlo Park (in the SF Bay Area) where Mary grew up. Brian was an attorney at a big law firm and Mary had started her own businesses in the area. Their ranch features two houses and the family lives between both. Situated just a few yards apart, the smaller cabin style home, affectionately called the Little House, is their primary residence as they continue to remodel the vintage farmhouse known as the Bunkhouse or the Big House.

feeds.title: Ranchlife Blog
feeds.description: Ranch Life Blog is your source to read articles about living a life on the ranch. Ranch Life is about the trials and tribulations of living in a log cabin. It is also the home for my new venture as a Neals Yard Organics Consultant. A range of amazing products, some of which I have used for many years, and some of which are new, both to the market and to me.

feeds.title: Rocking A Ranch Blog
feeds.description: As a small family farm, we're all about connecting, and bringing the farm to you. Here I share different tips, give you an insider's scoop on what farm life is about, and most importantly, connect with you about topics important to us all: sustainability, healthy eating, and living with integrity.

feeds.title: Farm Girl Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kenzie. I love Jesus. I'm a fireman's wife. girl mom, cowgal, store owner, cattle rancher, Hayfield meal delivery wagon, just to name a few hats that I wear. Farm Girl Blog gives you all the deets about who I am, where I come from, my passions, about my blog, services I offer and more.

feeds.title: McCafferty Ranch Blog
feeds.description: Our blog articles consist of Ranch news updates and exciting beef recipes. Learn what we have been up to, ranching insights, and How to make a delicious steak. McCafferty Ranch is a third-generation ranch outside of Belt, MT that has been family owned and operated since 1926.

feeds.title: Texas Ranch Life Blog
feeds.description: Ranch Blog by Lacey Elick, a Texas Rancher. Here she chronicles her Ranch life days and shares authentic Ranch ideas such as Horsemanship techniques, Recipes, and more. Follow us for behind-the-scenes, day-to-day life on the ranch, family recipes, stories, ranching resources & horsemanship.

feeds.title: Beef Runner
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Ryan Goodman, an agriculture advocate and cattle rancher who loves ultra-distance trail running. Beef is the primary protein you'll find in my kitchen and any chance I have to get away from the ranch, you'll find me traveling to explore new trails in our national parks and public lands. Explore my blog about running and travel fueled by beef.

feeds.title: Faith Family & Beef Blog
feeds.description: The Faith Family & Beef Blog by Terryn Drieling offers Positive thinking, Beef Recipes, Reflections on Faith, and a lot of other Ranch life tips. Terryn is a Nebrask-based Wife, Mother, Jesus lover, Coffee Junkie, and Dabbler in photography. She also offers Enneagram services.

feeds.title: The South Dakota Cowgirl Blog
feeds.description: Learn about Jenn Zeller and her life as the South Dakota Cowgirl. Through her blogs, she offers a lens of her positive, vibrant outlook on life. There's always something to learn on the ranch, whether it's about the horses, cattle, dogs, equipment, traditions, or people.

feeds.title: A Ranch Mom » Ranch Life
feeds.description: Read stories of life on a modern ranch, common lingo, tips for finding work, learn to be a cowboy, livestock photos and Wyoming ranches. Welcome, friend! My name is Kay. I am a stay-at-home mom, homeschooler, Wyoming gal, and disciple of Jesus. Here is my space to share stories from the ranch, motherhood encouragement, and homestyle recipes.

feeds.title: Frugal Living on the Ranch
feeds.description: I am married to my best friend. Between the two of us, we have 5 kids. We raise Black Angus cows in addition to farming, homesteading, prepping, working real jobs, and trying to live as frugally as we possibly can by making do with what we have. I enjoy sharing what few things I know with others in the hope to teach them something new or inspire them to look for a more sustainable, frugal lifestyle and to be prepared for whatever comes our way.

feeds.title: The Bull Sale Bulletin Blog
feeds.description: I'm Celeste Settrini. Through The Bull Sale Bulletin, I have created a spot to showcase ranching families who want to add a little extra pop to their bull sale promotions and events as well as a spot for the local sale barn and a video to promote the good they are doing. Here you will find videos, sale catalog links, photos, and other snippets that I hope will assist you when making a purchase from either a seed stock breeder or commercial cattle operation.

feeds.title: Life on the Ranch
feeds.description: Hi, My name is Tana. I live in the high desert of Nevada, It is heaven on earth. I am a rancher's wife and I want to share my story.

feeds.title: CavvySavvy Blog » Ranch Life
feeds.description: Our writers share Ranch life stories and experiences of a Cowboy work in this section. CavvySavvy is a sister company to Tri-State Livestock News. Our mission is to offer horse owners, professionals, and trainers a common channel to celebrate performance and working horses, and their ownership from beginning to end.

feeds.title: Bright Side Youth Ranch Blog
feeds.description: Bright Side Youth Ranch is a Ministry that serves children and teens ages 8-18 years old that are experiencing a crisis, both ongoing and current life challenges. In our blog, we share stories about our ranch life, our herd, life change, and the impact this ministry is making.
